summary: First full E2E run of the LearnFlow redesign (FastAPI + React). Backend: 24 pytest API tests covering auth, courses, enrolments, assignments, submissions with file upload, grading, attendance, results, notifications, discussions, stats and users. 21 passed and 3 failed. Frontend: Playwright checks on landing, catalogue, course detail, sign-in/up, every student/instructor/admin page, notification bell, live discussion, role-restricted page and the 390px mobile sidebar. All requested flows work end to end. When testing began the preview served a STALE webpack bundle (old catalogue design without data-testids). Restarting the frontend fixed it.

critical.issue: Demo login returns the NEWEST active user of that role (sort _order desc). After any new Student/Instructor sign-up, the 'Student'/'Instructor' demo buttons log into that new person's account. Reproduced: after registering a test student, demo-student logged in as 'TEST Stu2'. Fix: map each role to a fixed seeded email (alex.student@ / marcus.vance@ / admin@).

sio.emit('notification') broadcasts to ALL sockets, including private notifications that have a userId. App.jsx toasts every one without filtering. Reproduced: the instructor saw the toast 'Your submission for TEST_Asg has been evaluated: 44 marks' meant for the student. Fix: emit to a per-user room (join user_{id} on connect) when userId is set, or filter client-side by notif.userId.

The lockout never triggers. The identifier uses request.client.host, which is the ingress pod IP and changes between requests (seen in DB: 10.232.131.2 count 4, 10.232.135.73 count 2). Six bad attempts all return 401 and never 429. Fix: use the first IP in X-Forwarded-For, or key on email only.

minor.issue: Enrolling in a courseId that does not exist (or a draft course) returns 201 and creates an orphan enrolment. The student overview then shows a blank course card. Should return 404 (and reject drafts).
price='abc' gives a 500 (float() ValueError). Same risk for float(totalMarks) in POST /results and int(maxMarks) in POST /assignments. Validate the input and return 400.
studentId is optional. If it is missing, a result with studentId=None is stored and the notification is broadcast to everyone.
pendingToGrade counts Pending submissions across ALL instructors, not only the caller's courses.

No course scoping. Any logged-in user can read any course's discussion. An instructor can read every result and attendance record, including other instructors' courses (the instructor Results page lists the UI/UX course result).
Mass assignment: owners can overwrite enrolledCount, rating, reviewCount and similar fields.
Resubmitting a Graded submission silently wipes marks and feedback back to Pending. Confirm this is intended.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Open assignments' stat, the greeting text and 'Due soon' use assignments.slice(0,4) and ignore submission status and deadlines. Alex had submitted all 3 assignments, yet the page said '3 assignments open' and offered 'Submit'.

Fake numbers from hardcoded Redux initialState. attendanceSlice has presentCount 3, lateCount 1, rate 88. resultsSlice has cumulativeGpa 3.9. A new student with no data saw 'Total sessions 0' next to 'Present days 3, Late 1', and 'Cumulative GPA 3.90 / Distinction Honor Standing' with 0 graded courses. StudentResults also falls back to the hardcoded id 'user_student_1'. Use zeroed initial state and hide the distinction card when there are no results.
The roster lists every student on the platform, not only students enrolled in the selected course.

integration_issues.issue: At test start, the bundle on localhost:3000 and on the public URL was stale: it contained 'Explore the Catalog' and no 'catalogue-grid' even though the source was rewritten. touch did not trigger a rebuild. 'sudo supervisorctl restart frontend' fixed it, and hot reload worked afterwards. Main agent: if changes do not show up, restart the frontend.

issues: Tooltip is a dark navy box with dark-red text ('Enrolments : 560'): low contrast and a leftover of the old look
The enrolments series sits flat on the revenue axis (needs a second y-axis)
4 cards in a 3-column grid leave 1 orphan card on the second row; use 3 or 6 cards, or a 4-column grid
Content hugs the far-left edge with no navbar or brand; centre it in a max-width container
The form column starts at x=65 while the navbar content starts at x=288, so the alignment is inconsistent
On the Student demo card the two-line subtitle pushes its icon and title out of line with the other two cards
Uses the native browser datetime-local/date pickers instead of the shadcn Calendar
Submissions table has no assignment-title column, so you cannot tell which assignment a row belongs to
Delete uses native window.confirm instead of a styled dialog
Search icon is barely visible and the input has almost no border
The curriculum column does not stretch the full page height when you scroll down to the discussion
Two menu toggles (navbar hamburger and the 'Menu' button) is redundant
User 'Jai mehta' with a real-looking gmail address (pikkaboo46@gmail.com), joined today, appears in the admin and instructor rosters. Check whether this is a real person's data.

action_items: Make /api/auth/demo deterministic: fixed seeded email per role
Scope socket 'notification' emits to the target user (room per user), or filter by userId in App.jsx
Fix the brute-force identifier: use X-Forwarded-For first IP, or the email alone
POST /enrolments: return 404 for missing courses and reject drafts
Validate numeric fields (price, totalMarks, maxMarks) and return 400 instead of 500; require studentId in POST /results
StudentOverview: count only unsubmitted assignments that are not past their deadline
Remove hardcoded initialState stats in attendanceSlice/resultsSlice and the 'user_student_1' fallback
Instructor attendance roster: limit to students enrolled in the selected course
Scope discussions/results/attendance reads and stats.pendingToGrade to the caller's courses
Design fixes: Reports tooltip contrast, featured grid orphan, centred restricted page, shadcn date pickers
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 796 lines; split it into routers (auth, courses, coursework, stats, socket)
Endpoints take raw dict bodies with no Pydantic models, so a bad type becomes a 500

Playbook check: bcrypt hashes are $2b$ (OK). JWT is kept in localStorage and sent as a Bearer token; no httpOnly cookies are set. CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=False, so there are no explicit origins. Seeding runs only when the users collection is empty (idempotent, never resets passwords). Lockout is implemented but broken behind the ingress (see backend critical).

Many legacy pages (course player, student assignments/submit, instructor assignments/attendance/results/materials, admin users/courses) have almost no data-testids. I added navbar-notification-bell, navbar-notification-badge and navbar-notifications-mark-all to NotificationBell.jsx.
NotificationBell still uses bg-white/slate/dark: classes instead of the new design tokens

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (every requested flow works; data-correctness and design issues listed above)

test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is EMPTY (header only). The credentials from the review request work: alex.student@learnflow.edu / marcus.vance@learnflow.edu / admin@learnflow.edu with password LearnFlow@2026. Main agent should write them into the file.
seed_data_creation: Test-created users, courses, assignments, materials, discussions and notifications were cleaned up. Side effects that remain: Alex's result for course_react_mastery is now 72/B (overwritten by the UI test), Alex completed lesson 3 of React (progress 75%), an attendance session for 2026-10-28 on course_react_mastery, notifications read for Alex, and Alex's asg_2 submission was resubmitted (Pending).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/ -n 0. conftest.py cleans TEST_ data after the session (needed because demo login picks the newest user per role). The 3 expected failures are lockout, bad price → 500, and enrolment in a nonexistent course. Course player, assignments, attendance and results pages need text/role selectors because they lack testids. If the UI looks like the old design, restart the frontend (stale bundle seen once).
rca of the issue: 1) Demo hijack: demo_login uses find_one(role, sort _order desc); registered users get _order=time.time(), which is far larger than the seed _order values (1-5). 2) Notification leak: notify() calls sio.emit without room/to, and App.jsx handleNotification has no userId check. 3) Lockout: ident = request.client.host:email, and the host is a rotating ingress pod IP. 4) Fake stats: hardcoded attendanceSlice.initialState.studentStats and resultsSlice.cumulativeGpa=3.9; the student pages render these before or instead of real data.
